dog.description_text:
Miso is a 3-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 28 lbs, and she definitely knows how to turn heads. She has such a unique look, and right now she’s showing us a very calm, slightly timid side as she settles into her new surroundings.

She likes staying close to her people both at home and on walks, even if she’s not quite ready to be super touchy-feely yet. Miso seems eager to please and genuinely relieved to have a safe place to land. We have a feeling there’s a goofy, playful, more active side waiting to come out once she feels fully comfortable, and it’ll be fun to watch her personality unfold.

Registered adopters interested in Miso can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
